article.story: BOSTON -- — Mike Oberti’s 18 points helped Boston University defeat Harvard 81-72 on Tuesday. Oberti also contributed five rebounds for the Terriers (6-2). Kyrone Alexander scored 16 points and added six rebounds and three steals. Sam Hughes went 6 of 10 from the field (3 for 6 from 3-point range) to finish with 15 points. Tey Barbour led the way for the Crimson (3-5) with 32 points and two steals. Harvard also got 18 points, four assists and three steals from Robert Hinton. Thomas Batties II also had 10 points. BU led Harvard at the half, 37-33, with Oberti (eight points) its high scorer before the break. The Terriers took the lead for good with 11:09 remaining in the second half on a layup from Oberti to make it a 52-51 game. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
